Make ahead · PM

Sauces

Make a small jar of vinaigrette or one creamy sauce. Refrigerate, shake or stir before serving. Use certified gluten-free tamari when needed.

Creamy

Parsley–mint green sauce

Blend cottage cheese or Greek yogurt with parsley, a little mint, lemon, olive oil, Dijon, GF tamari, chili and salt. Loosen with water.

With: salmon, tofu, turkey, broccoli, corn and feta.

Egg-free spicy aioli

Whisk yogurt, cottage cheese or vegan mayo with chili-garlic sauce, lime, salt and a little olive oil.

With: salmon, shrimp, tofu, Mexican bowls.

Lemon-herb tahini

Whisk tahini, lemon, cold water, olive oil, salt and parsley or dill. Add water slowly until pourable.

With: white fish, chickpeas, cauliflower, feta.

Egg-free Caesar

Blend Greek yogurt or cottage cheese, lemon, Dijon, parmesan, garlic and black pepper. Thin with water.

With: romaine, broccoli, Brussels sprouts, Pacha croutons.

Vinaigrettes

Mediterranean red wine + lemon

Whisk 2 Tbsp red-wine vinegar, 1 Tbsp lemon juice, 1 small grated garlic clove, salt, pepper and 5–6 Tbsp olive oil.

With: green salads, fish, feta, tomato, cucumber, parsley.

Yuzu-ginger

Whisk yuzu vinegar, grated ginger, lime, certified GF tamari or coconut aminos, olive or sesame oil and chili.

With: salmon, shrimp, tofu, cucumber, carrot.

Black-currant Dijon

Whisk black currant vinegar, Dijon, olive oil, black pepper and a pinch of salt.

With: salmon, feta, walnuts, pomegranate, roasted vegetables.

Sherry-sage

Whisk sherry vinegar, Dijon, finely chopped sage, garlic, olive oil, salt and pepper.

With: chicken, turkey, mushrooms, Brussels sprouts, walnuts.

Apple-cider + Mexican mint

Whisk apple cider vinegar, lime, a little chopped mint-forward Mexican mint, cumin, olive oil and salt. Use the herb lightly.

With: corn, beans, turkey, mushrooms, cucumber.

Champagne-dill

Whisk champagne vinegar, lemon, Dijon, dill, olive oil, salt and pepper.

With: haddock, bass, salmon, cucumber, feta.

Cucumber-lemon

Whisk cucumber-lemon balsamic vinegar with lemon, olive oil, black pepper and a small pinch of salt.

With: cucumber, greens, smoked salmon, dill.

Vinegar pairing guide

Red wine

Tomato, feta, cucumber, parsley, fish.

Sherry

Mushrooms, poultry, Brussels sprouts, walnuts.

Yuzu

Salmon, shrimp, tofu, cucumber, ginger.

Apple cider

Turkey, corn, cabbage, cauliflower, cumin.

Champagne

Delicate fish, dill, cucumber, greens.

Black currant

Salmon, feta, pomegranate, walnuts.

White balsamic

Tomato, basil, zucchini, white fish.

Cucumber-lemon

Greens, smoked salmon, cucumber, dill.

Aged cherry

Tuna, walnuts, celery, feta.

Rice / moromi

Spicy fish, sprats, cucumber, sesame; check labels for gluten.

Dark-chocolate balsamic is a sparing finishing accent, not a main dressing. Skip balsamic glazes because of added sugar.
